### GET `/v1/organizations`

**List the organizations the caller belongs to**

Scoped to the session user. Soft-deleted organizations are omitted, because every route under them already answers 404. Paged with the canonical envelope `{ data, has_more, next_offset }` - BREAKING: `total`, `limit` and `offset` were removed. A `total` cost a second COUNT per request and, taken at a different instant from the rows, could not be used to derive the last page reliably; `has_more` states it. `next_offset` is null - never absent, never 0 - on the last page.

**Auth:** signed-in dashboard session (cookie).

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | query | number | no | 1 to 200; default `50` |  |
| `offset` | query | number | no | min 0; default `0` |  |

#### Responses

**200 OK** - [OrganizationListDto](./schemas.md#organizationlistdto)

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | [OrganizationDto](./schemas.md#organizationdto)[] | yes |  |  |
| `data[].id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `data[].name` | string | yes | max 200 chars |  |
| `data[].slug` | string | yes |  | Globally unique, URL-safe. |
| `data[].status` | string | yes | one of `active`, `suspended`, `deleted` |  |
| `data[].role` | string | yes | one of `owner`, `admin`, `developer`, `viewer`, `billing` | The requesting user's role in this organization. |
| `data[].created_at` | string | yes | format `date-time` |  |
| `data[].updated_at` | string | yes | format `date-time` |  |
| `has_more` | boolean | yes |  | True when more organizations match than this page carries. Read this, never a row count compared against `limit`, to decide whether you have seen them all. |
| `next_offset` | number \| null | yes |  | Pass back as `offset` to fetch the next page. NULL - never absent, never 0 - when this page was the last one, so a client branches on one thing. |

### POST `/v1/organizations`

**Create an organization**

The caller becomes its owner. The organization, the owner membership and the audit row are written in one transaction. An omitted slug is derived from the name and suffixed if it is taken; an explicitly supplied slug that is taken returns 409. Rate limited, and capped per account.

**Auth:** signed-in dashboard session (cookie).

#### Request body

`application/json`, required - [CreateOrganizationDto](./schemas.md#createorganizationdto)

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | 2 to 200 chars |  |
| `slug` | string | no | 2 to 48 chars | Lowercase letters, digits and single dashes. Derived from the name when omitted, with a random suffix if that name is taken. |

#### Responses

**201 Created** - [OrganizationDto](./schemas.md#organizationdto)

| Property | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | yes |  |  |
| `name` | string | yes | max 200 chars |  |
| `slug` | string | yes |  | Globally unique, URL-safe. |
| `status` | string | yes | one of `active`, `suspended`, `deleted` |  |
| `role` | string | yes | one of `owner`, `admin`, `developer`, `viewer`, `billing` | The requesting user's role in this organization. |
| `created_at` | string | yes | format `date-time` |  |
| `updated_at` | string | yes | format `date-time` |  |

**409 Conflict** - [ApiErrorResponse](./schemas.md#apierrorresponse)

Two different 409s, told apart by `error.code`, never by the message. `limit_exceeded` - the per-account organization cap is reached; `details` carries `{ limit, current, resource }`. `conflict` - the explicitly requested slug is already taken.

`error.code`: [`conflict`](./errors.md#conflict), [`limit_exceeded`](./errors.md#limit-exceeded), [`idempotency_key_reused`](./errors.md#idempotency-key-reused)

### DELETE `/v1/organizations/{orgId}`

**Soft-delete an organization**

Owner only, and never a hard delete: the delivery ledger hangs off this chain and its foreign keys are ON DELETE RESTRICT. Sets status=deleted, after which every route under the organization answers 404 for every member.

**Auth:** signed-in dashboard session (cookie).

#### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Constraints | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `orgId` | path | string | yes |  | Organization id, `org_…`. |

#### Responses

**204 No Content** - no body

**403 Forbidden** - [ApiErrorResponse](./schemas.md#apierrorresponse)

The caller is a member but is not an owner.

`error.code`: [`forbidden`](./errors.md#forbidden), [`email_not_verified`](./errors.md#email-not-verified)
